answer: Seed the queue with tasks whose correct answer is known and whose plausible answer is wrong. A farm answering by pattern picks the wrong one; the failure publishes account, submission and a fresh nonce so the record cannot be replayed. One honeypot in fifty tasks prices a farmer out, while the ocean of honest traffic hides which task is the trap. Each caught account stays as a relic in the ledger, and the fable of cheap automation dies there.
